t: An Arduino UNO robot car with a camera, sensors, and a phone app.
steps: Find the ELEGOO Smart Robot Car V4 on the ELEGOO site.
Ask IT to install the Arduino IDE on a lab computer.
Gather batteries, a USB cable and a screwdriver.
Assemble the car with an older student or an adult.
Install the phone app on a school tablet.
Upload an example sketch over USB.
Test obstacle avoidance in open space.
